title: Where to Get Help and Support for Development on the Internet Computer
section: 38. Build Your First Defi (Decentralised Finance) DApp - DBANK
summary: A short resource article listing where to look for help when building on the Internet Computer: official docs, the CLI reference, the Dfinity forum and its developer Discord.

concepts.heading: Support channels listed
points: Official developer docs for the Internet Computer (the introduction and guides).
Command-line reference for dfx, useful when a command or flag is unfamiliar.
Official Dfinity forum for questions and discussions.
Official Dfinity developer Discord for quick community help.

(Extra) The lecture page itself only exposes an Open button for the external link; the link list above comes from the course's reference repo copy. The old smartcontracts.org docs address has since moved to internetcomputer.org/docs, so check current URLs.
